Madhya Pradesh Fuel Stations Cap UPI Payments at Rs 2,000

Fuel stations in Madhya Pradesh will stop accepting UPI payments for transactions exceeding Rs 2,000 starting October 16. This decision was made by petrol pump operators in the state. The move aims to address issues related to UPI transaction charges and settlement times.
